summary: Full backend + frontend testing of StudyLocus JEE 2027 dashboard. All 16 pytest backend tests pass (auth, settings, tasks/studylogs/tests/scores CRUD, data isolation, no _id leak). Full E2E frontend flow via Playwright passes: register->dashboard, 8 cards render, task add/toggle/progress, study log timer+log, test planner add, mock score add + chart, quote rotation, reload persistence, logout, admin login, and cross-user data isolation.

issues: Uses browser-native date input (mm/dd/yyyy) instead of shadcn Calendar/Popover component — inconsistent with dark theme aesthetic.

action_items: Optional: replace native <input type=date> in Test Planner with shadcn Calendar for theme consistency.
Optional: address React Router v7 future flag warnings (v7_startTransition, v7_relativeSplatPath) — harmless deprecation notices.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend uses on_event('startup') which is deprecated in FastAPI; consider lifespan handlers.
set_auth_cookie uses SameSite=None; Secure=True — correct for cross-site preview URL, good.
No rate limiting / brute-force lockout implemented (playbook mentions 5-fail lockout) — not enforced. Not present in original spec, but flag as potential enhancement.
clean() mutates the input dict in-place; benign here but worth noting.
Quote 'change' logic is client-side only (built-in rotating quotes) — verified working.
test_credentials: admin@studylocus.com / admin123 (verified working). New users register at /login with any email + 6+ char password.
seed_data_creation: Test users created dynamically per run with example.com emails and TEST_ prefixed tasks/tests/scores. Note: .test TLD rejected by pydantic EmailStr (reserved) — switched to @example.com.
context_for_next_testing_agent: backend_test.py covers all endpoints. Use @example.com emails (not .test — reserved TLD rejected by pydantic). data-testid attributes are consistent across cards. Dashboard title text is 'JEE 2027'. Mock score modal has 4 number inputs (phy/chem/math/maxMarks or similar order).
rca of the issue: N/A — no failing tests. Only minor initial test setup issue with '.test' TLD being reserved by pydantic email-validator was resolved by using @example.com in tests.
